name: floss
description: Extract obfuscated strings from malware using static analysis and emulation techniques

floss.description: FireEye Labs Obfuscated String Solver - extract hidden and encoded strings from PE files
floss.usage:
floss malware.exe
floss -n 8 malware.exe
floss --no-static-strings malware.exe
floss -o results.json malware.exe
floss --only tight malware.exe
